% Mutation of tcolorbox_unknown_height_anchors: a picture reads a node's
% anchor before and after the box; neither leaves \southwest defined.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{skins}
\newtcolorbox{sbx}{blanker,underlay={\fill (frame.south west) -- (frame.north east);}}
\newdimen\uh \uh=\pdfelapsedtime sp
\begin{document}
\tikz{\node (a) {x}; \fill (a.south west) -- (a.north east);}
\makeatletter
\ifx\southwest\undefined\gdef\AfterFirstPicture{}\fi
\makeatother
\begin{sbx}\rule{1pt}{\uh}\end{sbx}
\tikz{\node (b) {y}; \fill (b.south west) -- (b.north east);}
\makeatletter
\ifnum\currentgrouplevel=0 \ifx\southwest\undefined\gdef\AfterBoxGroupsClosed{}\fi\fi
\makeatother
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
